mapper.sql: id, order_no, source_appeal_id, title, content, category, sub_category, level, attention_count, confidence, hit_keywords, need_review, region, county_code, county_name, department, street_office, dept_receive_time, street_receive_time, street_code, street_name, address_detail, is_broad, status, same_source_order_id, event_type, dispose_plan, dispose_result, dispose_tag, dispose_time, dispose_user_id, dispose_user_name, deadline, is_overdue, delay_count, street_return_count, dept_return_count, dept_audit_status, dept_audit_time, dept_audit_user_id, dept_audit_user_name, dept_audit_remark, dept_score, dept_score_time, final_audit_status, final_audit_time, final_audit_user_id, final_audit_user_name, final_audit_remark, final_reject_target, archive_time, archive_type, is_archived, reopen_count, close_time, is_completed, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dept_work_order WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dept_work_order SELECT * FROM admin_work_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_STREET_PROCESS' OR status IN ('PENDING_DEPT_ASSIGN', 'STREET_REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_handle, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_DEPT_PROCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_verify, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_DEPT_ASSIGN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_assign, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_EVALUATE', 'EVALUATED', 'STREET_DONE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_audit, SUM(CASE WHEN year(dispose_time) = #{year} AND month(dispose_time) = #{month} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_done, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN dept_score IS NOT NULL THEN dept_score END), 0) AS avg_score FROM dept_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category = #{category} AND county_code = #{countyCode}

SELECT street_office, COUNT(1) AS cnt, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(dept_score), 1), 0) AS avg_score, SUM(CASE WHEN dept_audit_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved, SUM(CASE WHEN is_overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, dispose_time)), 1), 0) AS avg_hours FROM dept_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category = #{department} AND county_code = #{countyCode} AND dispose_time IS NOT NULL AND dispose_time >= #{start} GROUP BY street_office ORDER BY cnt DESC
